brief.title: Global Smartwatch Secondary Market Analysis — Q1 2026
brief.one_liner: A comprehensive analysis of 3,600+ secondary-market smartwatch listings across Apple, Garmin, and Samsung to uncover pricing dynamics, geographic arbitrage opportunities, and seller behavior patterns.
brief.goal: The reader should understand how smartwatch brands retain value on the resale market, identify geographic pricing discrepancies, assess the impact of case size and condition on price, and recognize power-seller pricing strategies — ultimately informing sourcing, pricing, and inventory decisions for secondary-market e-commerce operations.

required_sections.title: Market Overview & Listing Composition
required_sections.objective: Summarize the overall dataset: total listings, brand distribution, condition mix, and geographic spread. Provide a high-level snapshot of the secondary smartwatch marketplace.

required_sections.title: Brand-Level Pricing & Value Retention
required_sections.objective: Compare average, median, and price range across Apple, Garmin, and Samsung. Identify which brand commands the highest resale premiums and which shows the widest price variance.

required_sections.title: Geographic Pricing Arbitrage
required_sections.objective: Analyze price differences by country for each brand. Highlight regions where specific brands are significantly cheaper or more expensive, identifying potential arbitrage opportunities.

required_sections.title: Case Size & Price Premium Analysis
required_sections.objective: Examine the relationship between Case_Size_mm and listing price. Determine whether larger watch faces command a measurable premium and how this varies by brand.

required_sections.title: Power Seller Behavior & Pricing Patterns
required_sections.objective: Identify high-volume sellers and compare their pricing strategies against low-volume sellers. Assess whether power sellers price higher or lower and whether they favor specific brands or conditions.

required_sections.title: Strategic Recommendations
required_sections.objective: Synthesize findings into actionable recommendations for secondary-market operators regarding sourcing regions, brand focus, pricing strategies, and seller partnership opportunities.

kpis.name: Median Listing Price by Brand
kpis.description: The median price (USD) of listings for each brand (Apple, Garmin, Samsung), serving as the central measure of resale value.

kpis.name: Geographic Price Spread
kpis.description: The difference between the highest and lowest country-level median price for each brand, quantifying arbitrage potential.

kpis.name: Case Size Price Correlation
kpis.description: The correlation coefficient between Case_Size_mm and price, measuring how strongly physical size predicts resale value.

kpis.name: Power Seller Concentration
kpis.description: The percentage of total listings attributable to the top 5% of sellers by volume, indicating market concentration.

kpis.name: New vs. Used Price Premium
kpis.description: The average percentage price premium that 'New' condition listings command over 'Used' listings, by brand.
